name: HoldToConfirm
description: A press-and-hold button for destructive actions: holding sweeps an accent fill across the button (the label inverts as it is covered), releasing early drains it back, and completing the hold fires onConfirm with a pop and a check mark before resetting.
a11yNotes: Native <button> described by a visually hidden hint ("Press and hold, or hold Space or Enter, to confirm"). Holding Space or Enter works like a pointer hold (key repeat is ignored, keyup or blur cancels). A polite role="status" region announces the confirmed label, and the button is aria-disabled until it resets. Progress is driven by requestAnimationFrame through a CSS variable without re-rendering. Under prefers-reduced-motion the press scale and confirm pop are removed; the progress fill remains because it conveys state.

propsApi.name: holdingLabel
propsApi.description: Label shown while the button is held.

propsApi.name: holdDuration
propsApi.description: Milliseconds the button must be held (minimum 200).

propsApi.name: resetAfter
propsApi.description: Milliseconds after confirming before it resets; 0 keeps it confirmed.

propsApi.name: fillStyle
propsApi.description: Sweep the whole button with an inverting label, or grow a thin bar along the bottom.

propsApi.name: haptics
propsApi.description: Call navigator.vibrate on confirm where supported.

propsApi.name: onCancel
propsApi.description: Called when a hold is released before completing.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
